items.a: The easiest way to begin is to book a free 15-minute discovery call through the contact page. It is a relaxed, no-obligation conversation where you can share a little about what is on your mind and ask any questions. If it feels like a good fit, we can arrange a first session together. There is no diagnosis or referral needed to start.

items.q: What happens in the free 15-minute discovery call?
items.a: The discovery call is a free, relaxed 15-minute conversation with no obligation. It is a chance for us to say hello, for you to describe what you are hoping for, and for you to get a feel for how I work. You are welcome to ask anything, including about fees and practical details. If it feels right, we can plan a first session from there.

items.q: What can I expect in a first session?
items.a: A first session lasts around 60 minutes and takes place online via video. We take our time to get to know each other and to explore what has brought you here and what you would like to focus on. There is no pressure to have everything figured out. My aim is for you to feel heard, safe, and comfortable to move at your own pace.

items.q: How do I know if counselling is right for me?
items.a: Counselling can be a good fit if you would value a warm, confidential space to reflect, gain clarity, or navigate something that feels difficult. The free discovery call is designed exactly for this question, so you can get a sense of whether working together feels right for you. There is no need to decide in advance. You are always welcome to take your time.

items.q: Do I need a specific reason to start counselling?
items.a: Not at all. Some people arrive with a clear concern, while others simply feel that something is out of balance or want space to think things through. Any reason that matters to you is reason enough. You are welcome just as you are.

items.q: How many sessions will I need?
items.a: There is no fixed number, as everyone's needs and goals are different. Some people find a few sessions helpful, while others value a longer, ongoing space over time. We can talk about what feels right for you and review it together as we go. You remain in charge of the pace and the length of our work.

The rhythm is something we shape together to suit you. Many people begin with weekly or fortnightly sessions and adjust from there as needs change. Sessions are online, or in person in Zug by arrangement. We can find a frequency that feels supportive and sustainable for you.
